title: Acidic oxide
content: An acidic oxide is a non-metallic oxide which reacts with basic oxide to produce salt[cite: 1].

title: Basic oxide
content: A basic oxide is a metallic oxide which reacts with acid to form salt and water[cite: 1].

title: Amphoteric oxide
content: An amphoteric oxide is a metallic oxide which possesses both basic and acidic properties[cite: 1].

title: Neutral oxide
content: A neutral oxide does not react with either acids or bases[cite: 1].

title: Peroxide
content: A peroxide reacts with an acid to produce salt and hydrogen peroxide[cite: 1].

title: Compound oxide
content: A compound oxide is the combination of two different oxides of the same element[cite: 1].

title: Allotrope
content: Allotrope refers to two or more forms of an element that occur in the same physical state but different in properties[cite: 1].

title: Silver nitrate test
content: Silver nitrate test is used to detect the presence of halide ions[cite: 1].
